books/runs.lisp:
; Layer C: multi-page runs. Level 0 holds the entries; each sealed page's
; first key and parent-held reference become one entry of the level above.
; A build owns one writer row per level; its caller supplies pages and
; records each sealed page. Every call is bounded; :more resumes.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "run-geometry")
(include-book "runs-schema")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
; B's and A's shape lemmas are stated over the rows accessors; keep them folded.
(local (in-theory (disable fn2-pool-rows fn2-fields-rows fn2-digests-rows fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc-context-rows fn2-b3-rows)))

; A format parameter, not a ceiling on stored entries: with 64 KiB pages and
; index entries of at most 350 bytes, six levels address over 10^13 pages.

; Field rows a build owns: one writer range per level, then one index-entry
; region where a sealed page's first key and reference are assembled.
(defconst *fn2-run-build-index* (* *fn2-run-max-levels* *fn2-run-writer-fields*))
(defconst *fn2-run-build-fields* (+ *fn2-run-build-index* *fn2-run-entry-rows*))

(defcolumns fn2-run-builds
 ((phase (:enum fn2-run-build-phase (:idle :adding :finishing :done :failed)))
  (schema :u60) (run :u60) (height :u8) (wbase :u32) (entries :u60) (pages :u60)
  (crow :u32) (hbase :u32) (hslot :u32) (hgen :u60) (fields :u32) (limit :u32)
  (history :u60) (incarnation :u60) (okind :u8) (oslot :u32) (ogen :u60)))

(defun fn2-run-buildp (b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers) :guard t))
 (and (fn2-run-builds-wfp fn2-run-builds) (fn2-run-writers-wfp fn2-run-writers)
      (natp b) (< b (fn2-run-builds-rows fn2-run-builds))
      (<= (+ (fn2-run-builds-wbase b fn2-run-builds) *fn2-run-max-levels*)
          (fn2-run-writers-rows fn2-run-writers))))
(defmacro fn2-run-level-writer (b level)
 `(+ (fn2-run-builds-wbase ,b fn2-run-builds) ,level))
(defmacro fn2-run-level-phase (b level)
 `(fn2-run-writers-phase (fn2-run-level-writer ,b ,level) fn2-run-writers))

; Idle every level writer of a build, ordinal zero.
(defun fn2-run-reset-writers (n w fn2-run-writers)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-writers :measure (nfix n)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-writers-wfp fn2-run-writers) (natp n) (natp w))))
 (cond ((zp n) (mv :ok fn2-run-writers))
       ((not (and (natp w) (< (+ w (- n 1)) (fn2-run-writers-rows fn2-run-writers)))) (mv :bounds fn2-run-writers))
       (t (let ((fn2-run-writers (fn2-run-writers-put (+ w (- n 1)) (phase *fn2-run-writer-phase-idle*) (ordinal 0))))
           (fn2-run-reset-writers (- n 1) w fn2-run-writers)))))
(fn2-run-writers-preserves fn2-run-reset-writers (n w fn2-run-writers) :position 1 :raw-rows t)

; Start a build. The hash slot is a C-owned workspace whose first
; 32 * levels bytes are zeroed here; level L's sealed hash is copied to
; offset 32 L for its parent entry.
(defun fn2-run-build-start (b schema run wbase crow hbase hslot hgen fields limit history incarnation
                             okind oslot ogen fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-builds-wfp fn2-run-builds) (fn2-run-writers-wfp fn2-run-writers) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp b) (< b (fn2-run-builds-rows fn2-run-builds))
                    (unsigned-byte-p 60 schema) (unsigned-byte-p 60 run) (unsigned-byte-p 32 wbase)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 crow) (unsigned-byte-p 32 hbase) (unsigned-byte-p 32 hslot)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 60 hgen) (unsigned-byte-p 32 fields) (unsigned-byte-p 32 limit)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 60 history) (unsigned-byte-p 60 incarnation)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 8 okind) (unsigned-byte-p 32 oslot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 ogen)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
      ((unless (member (fn2-run-builds-phase b fn2-run-builds)
                       (list *fn2-run-build-phase-idle* *fn2-run-build-phase-done*)))
       (mv :state fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
      ((mv code fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-reset hslot hgen okind oslot ogen fn2-pool))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
      ((mv code fn2-pool) (fn2-run-zero (* 32 *fn2-run-max-levels*) hslot hgen 0 okind oslot ogen fn2-pool))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
      ((mv code fn2-run-writers) (fn2-run-reset-writers *fn2-run-max-levels* wbase fn2-run-writers))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
      (fn2-run-builds (fn2-run-builds-put b (phase *fn2-run-build-phase-adding*) (schema schema) (run run)
                        (height 0) (wbase wbase) (entries 0) (pages 0) (crow crow) (hbase hbase)
                        (hslot hslot) (hgen hgen) (fields fields) (limit limit)
                        (history history) (incarnation incarnation) (okind okind) (oslot oslot) (ogen ogen))))
  (mv :ok fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)))
(fn2-run-builds-preserves fn2-run-build-start (b schema run wbase crow hbase hslot hgen fields limit history incarnation okind oslot ogen fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 :position 1 :disable nil
 :hyps ((fn2-run-buildsp fn2-run-builds) (fn2-run-builds-wfp fn2-run-builds)))
(fn2-run-writers-preserves fn2-run-build-start (b schema run wbase crow hbase hslot hgen fields limit history incarnation okind oslot ogen fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 :position 2 :prefix "-WRITERS-PRESERVES" :disable nil)
(fn2-pool-preserves fn2-run-build-start (b schema run wbase crow hbase hslot hgen fields limit history incarnation okind oslot ogen fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 :position 3 :prefix "-POOL-PRESERVES")

; Give level LEVEL a fresh page: a C-owned 64 KiB workspace and its physical
; identity, from the caller's allocator reservation. The page's ordinal is
; the build's page count at that level, kept in the writer row across pages.
(defun fn2-run-build-page-kind (b level slot gen unit epoch counter page-kind fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-buildp b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))))
 (b* (((unless (and (unsigned-byte-p 8 page-kind) (natp level) (< level *fn2-run-max-levels*)
                    (< level (fn2-run-builds-height b fn2-run-builds))))
       (mv :bounds fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
      (w (fn2-run-level-writer b level))
      ((unless (equal (fn2-run-writers-phase w fn2-run-writers) *fn2-run-writer-phase-idle*))
       (mv :state fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
      (ordinal (fn2-run-writers-ordinal w fn2-run-writers))
      ((mv code fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
       (fn2-run-open w slot gen (fn2-run-builds-schema b fn2-run-builds) 1 level
                     (fn2-run-builds-run b fn2-run-builds) ordinal
                     page-kind
                     unit epoch counter (fn2-run-builds-history b fn2-run-builds)
                     (fn2-run-builds-incarnation b fn2-run-builds)
                     (fn2-run-builds-okind b fn2-run-builds) (fn2-run-builds-oslot b fn2-run-builds)
                     (fn2-run-builds-ogen b fn2-run-builds)
                     (+ (fn2-run-builds-fields b fn2-run-builds) (* level *fn2-run-writer-fields*))
                     (fn2-run-builds-limit b fn2-run-builds) fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)))
  (mv code fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)))
; Default callers retain the ordinary run page kinds. A directory producer
; uses the same implementation with its declared :manifest page kind.
(defun fn2-run-build-page (b level slot gen unit epoch counter fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-buildp b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))))
 (fn2-run-build-page-kind b level slot gen unit epoch counter
  (if (zp level) *page-kind-run-data* *page-kind-run-index*) fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool))
(fn2-run-builds-preserves fn2-run-build-page (b level slot gen unit epoch counter fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 :position 1 :disable nil)
(fn2-run-writers-preserves fn2-run-build-page (b level slot gen unit epoch counter fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 :position 2 :prefix "-WRITERS-PRESERVES" :disable nil :raw-rows t
 :hyps ((fn2-run-writersp fn2-run-writers) (fn2-run-buildsp fn2-run-builds) (fn2-run-buildp b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)))
(fn2-pool-preserves fn2-run-build-page (b level slot gen unit epoch counter fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-pool)
 :position 3 :prefix "-POOL-PRESERVES")

; All levels below L idle.
(defun fn2-run-below-idle (l wbase fn2-run-writers)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-writers :measure (nfix l)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-writers-wfp fn2-run-writers) (natp l) (natp wbase)
              (<= (+ wbase l) (fn2-run-writers-rows fn2-run-writers)))))
 (or (zp l)
     (and (equal (fn2-run-writers-phase (+ wbase (- l 1)) fn2-run-writers) *fn2-run-writer-phase-idle*)
          (fn2-run-below-idle (- l 1) wbase fn2-run-writers))))
; The highest level that needs action, top down: (mv action level).
(defun fn2-run-scan (l b finishing fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers) :measure (nfix (+ 1 l))
  :guard (and (fn2-run-buildp b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers) (integerp l) (< l *fn2-run-max-levels*))))
 (if (or (not (integerp l)) (< l 0)) (mv :idle 0)
  (let* ((wbase (fn2-run-builds-wbase b fn2-run-builds)) (w (+ wbase l))
         (phase (fn2-run-writers-phase w fn2-run-writers)))
   (cond ((equal phase *fn2-run-writer-phase-closing*) (mv :close-step l))
         ((equal phase *fn2-run-writer-phase-heading*) (mv :head l))
         ((equal phase *fn2-run-writer-phase-sealing*) (mv :seal-step l))
         ((equal phase *fn2-run-writer-phase-failed*) (mv :failed l))
         ((equal phase *fn2-run-writer-phase-sealed*)
          (if (and finishing (equal (+ 1 l) (fn2-run-builds-height b fn2-run-builds))
                   (equal (fn2-run-writers-ordinal w fn2-run-writers) 0)
                   (fn2-run-below-idle l wbase fn2-run-writers))
              (mv :root l) (mv :promote l)))
         ((equal phase *fn2-run-writer-phase-idle*)
          (if (and (< 0 l) (equal (fn2-run-writers-phase (+ wbase (- l 1)) fn2-run-writers) *fn2-run-writer-phase-sealed*))
              (mv :need-page l)
            (fn2-run-scan (- l 1) b finishing fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)))
         ((and finishing (fn2-run-below-idle l wbase fn2-run-writers)) (mv :finish-close l))
         (t (fn2-run-scan (- l 1) b finishing fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers))))))

(defthm fn2-run-scan-level-natp
 (natp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-run-scan l b finishing fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)))
 :rule-classes ((:type-prescription :typed-term (mv-nth 1 (fn2-run-scan l b finishing fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)))))

; One bounded unit of pending page work. Returns (mv code level ...): :more
; after work, (:sealed L) once when a page has sealed (its writer row then
; names the page; the caller records it), and without work (:promote L),
; (:need-page L), (:root L) or :idle for the caller to act on.
(defun fn2-run-build-work (b budget fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool
                             fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-buildp b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers) (fn2-run-restarts-wfp fn2-run-restarts)
              (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool) (fn2-fc-wfp fn2-fc)
              (fn2-fc-context-wfp fn2-fc-context) (fn2-digests-wfp fn2-digests) (natp budget))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-run-scan fn2-run-close-step fn2-run-head fn2-run-seal-step fn2-run-seal-context fn2-run-close
                                            fn2-run-writers-rows fn2-fields-rows fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc-context-rows)))))
 (b* ((finishing (equal (fn2-run-builds-phase b fn2-run-builds) *fn2-run-build-phase-finishing*))
      (height (fn2-run-builds-height b fn2-run-builds))
      ((unless (<= height *fn2-run-max-levels*))
       (mv :bounds 0 fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests))
      ((mv action l) (fn2-run-scan (- height 1) b finishing fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers))
      (w (+ (fn2-run-builds-wbase b fn2-run-builds) l))
      (crow (fn2-run-builds-crow b fn2-run-builds))
      (hrow (+ (fn2-run-builds-hbase b fn2-run-builds) l))
      ((unless (and (natp l) (< w (fn2-run-writers-rows fn2-run-writers))
                    (fn2-run-writerp w fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields)
                    (< crow (fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc)) (< crow (fn2-fc-context-rows fn2-fc-context))
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 hrow)))
       (mv :bounds l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))
  (case action
   (:close-step
    (b* (((mv code fn2-run-writers fn2-fields fn2-pool)
          (fn2-run-close-step w budget fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
     (mv (if (member-eq code '(:ok :more)) :more code) l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))
   (:head
    (b* (((mv code fn2-run-writers fn2-fields fn2-pool) (fn2-run-head w fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool))
         ((unless (and (eq code :ok) (< (fn2-digest-slot crow *fn2-fc-previous-seal*) 4294967296)))
          (mv (if (eq code :ok) :bounds code) l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests))
         (fn2-fc-context (fn2-run-seal-context w crow hrow fn2-run-writers fn2-fc-context)))
     (mv :more l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))
   (:seal-step
    (b* (((mv code fn2-run-writers fn2-fc fn2-b3 fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-digests)
          (fn2-run-seal-step w crow hrow budget fn2-run-writers fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-digests))
         (pages (+ 1 (fn2-run-builds-pages b fn2-run-builds)))
         (fn2-run-builds (if (and (eq code :ok) (unsigned-byte-p 60 pages))
                             (fn2-run-builds-set-pages b pages fn2-run-builds) fn2-run-builds)))
     (mv (case code (:ok :sealed) (:more :more) (otherwise code))
         l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))
   (:finish-close
    (b* (((mv code fn2-run-writers) (fn2-run-close w fn2-run-writers)))
     (mv (if (eq code :ok) :more code) l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))
   (:root
    (let ((fn2-run-builds (fn2-run-builds-set-phase b *fn2-run-build-phase-done* fn2-run-builds)))
     (mv :root l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))
   (otherwise
    (mv action l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers fn2-run-restarts fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-fc fn2-fc-context fn2-b3 fn2-digests)))))

; Finishing: the remaining open levels close bottom up; an empty run has no
; root and is :empty.
(defun fn2-run-build-finish (b fn2-run-builds)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-builds
  :guard (and (fn2-run-builds-wfp fn2-run-builds) (natp b) (< b (fn2-run-builds-rows fn2-run-builds)))))
 (cond ((not (equal (fn2-run-builds-phase b fn2-run-builds) *fn2-run-build-phase-adding*)) (mv :state fn2-run-builds))
       ((zp (fn2-run-builds-entries b fn2-run-builds))
        (let ((fn2-run-builds (fn2-run-builds-set-phase b *fn2-run-build-phase-done* fn2-run-builds))) (mv :empty fn2-run-builds)))
       (t (let ((fn2-run-builds (fn2-run-builds-set-phase b *fn2-run-build-phase-finishing* fn2-run-builds))) (mv :ok fn2-run-builds)))))

; Promotion, the generic parts. Check: the sealed level L can promote now
; (:go), or the level above needs a page first, growing the height when L is
; the top. Child reference: the parent-held hash goes to the hash slot at
; 32 L and the reference fields are set by the ref layout's field names
; relative to CB, the index layout's CHILD- base. Commit: :full closes the
; parent (the promotion stays pending); :ok idles L for its next page.
(defun fn2-run-promote-check (b l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-buildp b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers) (natp l))))
 (b* ((wbase (fn2-run-builds-wbase b fn2-run-builds))
      ((unless (and (natp l) (< (+ 1 l) *fn2-run-max-levels*) (< l (fn2-run-builds-height b fn2-run-builds))))
       (mv :levels fn2-run-builds))
      ((unless (equal (fn2-run-writers-phase (+ wbase l) fn2-run-writers) *fn2-run-writer-phase-sealed*))
       (mv :state fn2-run-builds))
      ((when (equal (+ 1 l) (fn2-run-builds-height b fn2-run-builds)))
       (let ((fn2-run-builds (fn2-run-builds-set-height b (+ 2 l) fn2-run-builds))) (mv :need-page fn2-run-builds)))
      ((when (equal (fn2-run-writers-phase (+ wbase l 1) fn2-run-writers) *fn2-run-writer-phase-idle*))
       (mv :need-page fn2-run-builds)))
  (mv :go fn2-run-builds)))
(fn2-fc-shape fn2-run-promote-check-shape (fn2-run-promote-check b l fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers)
 (and (fn2-run-buildsp fn2-run-builds) (fn2-run-writersp fn2-run-writers) (fn2-run-buildp b fn2-run-builds fn2-run-writers))
 ((fn2-run-builds 1)))
(in-theory (disable fn2-run-promote-check))

(defun fn2-run-child-ref (w l cb eb hrow hslot hgen okind oslot ogen fn2-run-writers fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-digests)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-writers fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-digests)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-writers-wfp fn2-run-writers) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields)
              (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool) (fn2-digests-wfp fn2-digests))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp w) (natp l) (natp cb) (natp eb) (< l *fn2-run-max-levels*)
                    (< w (fn2-run-writers-rows fn2-run-writers))
                    (<= (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-num-fields*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
                    (< eb (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 hslot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 hgen) (fn2-digest-rowp hrow fn2-digests)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((mv code fn2-pool) (fn2-digest-store 32 hrow hslot hgen (* 32 l) okind oslot ogen fn2-digests fn2-pool))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      (unit (fn2-run-writers-unit w fn2-run-writers)) (epoch (fn2-run-writers-epoch w fn2-run-writers))
      (counter (fn2-run-writers-counter w fn2-run-writers)) (kind (fn2-run-writers-page-kind w fn2-run-writers))
      (entries (fn2-run-writers-entries w fn2-run-writers)))
  (if (not (and (unsigned-byte-p 60 unit) (unsigned-byte-p 60 epoch) (unsigned-byte-p 60 counter)
                (unsigned-byte-p 60 kind) (unsigned-byte-p 60 entries)))
      (mv :bounds fn2-fields fn2-pool)
   (let* ((h (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-field-expected-hash*))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-field-storage-domain*) 0 fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-field-physical-unit*) unit fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-field-writer-epoch*) epoch fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-field-allocation*) counter fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-field-page-kind*) kind fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ cb *fn2-format-ref-field-encoded-length*) *fn2-run-page-size* fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value h 1 fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-ref-slot h hslot fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-ref-gen h hgen fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-ref-off h (* 32 l) fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-ref-len h 32 fn2-fields))
          (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value eb entries fn2-fields)))
    (mv :ok fn2-fields fn2-pool)))))
(fn2-fc-shape fn2-run-child-ref-shape
 (fn2-run-child-ref w l cb eb hrow hslot hgen okind oslot ogen fn2-run-writers fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-digests)
 (and (fn2-run-writersp fn2-run-writers) (fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields) (fn2-poolp fn2-pool) (fn2-digestsp fn2-digests)

; stay cached until the sealer releases them unit by unit (sealer.lisp).
(defun fn2-run-retire (r fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :guard (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed)))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp r) (< r (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed)))) (mv :bounds fn2-run-installed))
      ((unless (equal (fn2-run-installed-state r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-installed-state-live*))
       (mv :state fn2-run-installed))
      (fn2-run-installed (fn2-run-installed-put r (state *fn2-run-installed-state-retired*))))
  (mv :ok fn2-run-installed)))
(fn2-run-installed-preserves fn2-run-retire (r fn2-run-installed) :position 1 :raw-rows t)
; Retired run R's next unit is released: UFIRST moves on, and the row is
; free once it passes ULAST.
; Called only after the higher source/promise check. Row reuse does not
; release physical bytes, catalog metadata or immutable query leases.
(defun fn2-run-free-physical (r fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :guard (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed)))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp r) (< r (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed)))) (mv :bounds fn2-run-installed))
      ((unless (and (= (fn2-run-installed-state r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-installed-state-retired*)
                    (= (fn2-run-installed-physical r fn2-run-installed) 1))) (mv :state fn2-run-installed))
      (count (fn2-run-installed-physical-count fn2-run-installed))
      ((unless (posp count)) (mv :coverage fn2-run-installed))
      (fn2-run-installed (fn2-run-installed-put r (state *fn2-run-installed-state-free*) (physical 0) (catalog-tag 0)))
      (fn2-run-installed (update-fn2-run-installed-physical-count (- count 1) fn2-run-installed)))
  (mv :ok fn2-run-installed)))
(fn2-run-installed-preserves fn2-run-free-physical (r fn2-run-installed) :position 1 :raw-rows t)

(defun fn2-run-retired-next (r fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :guard (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed)))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp r) (< r (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed)))) (mv :bounds fn2-run-installed))
      ((unless (equal (fn2-run-installed-state r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-installed-state-retired*))
       (mv :state fn2-run-installed))
            ((when (= (fn2-run-installed-physical r fn2-run-installed) 1)) (mv :physical fn2-run-installed))
(next (+ 1 (nfix (fn2-run-installed-ufirst r fn2-run-installed))))
      ((unless (unsigned-byte-p 60 next)) (mv :bounds fn2-run-installed))
      (fn2-run-installed (if (< (nfix (fn2-run-installed-ulast r fn2-run-installed)) next)
                             (fn2-run-installed-put r (state *fn2-run-installed-state-free*) (ufirst next))
                           (fn2-run-installed-put r (ufirst next)))))
  (mv :ok fn2-run-installed)))
(fn2-run-installed-preserves fn2-run-retired-next (r fn2-run-installed) :position 1 :raw-rows t)
; A schema's version: the greatest run identifier among its live runs.
; Run identifiers only grow, and every installation (a seal, C5's merge)
; installs a new one, so the version moves whenever facts move from an
; overlay into a run. A reader that holds it (an identity decision, a range
; read) knows by comparing it whether its sources moved under it.
(defun fn2-run-version (sid n fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :measure (nfix n)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (natp n) (<= n (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed)))))
 (if (zp n) 0
  (let ((r (- n 1)) (rest (fn2-run-version sid (- n 1) fn2-run-installed)))
   (if (and (equal (fn2-run-installed-state r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-installed-state-live*)
            (equal (fn2-run-installed-schema r fn2-run-installed) sid)
            (< rest (nfix (fn2-run-installed-run r fn2-run-installed))))
       (nfix (fn2-run-installed-run r fn2-run-installed)) rest))))
(defthm fn2-run-version-natp (natp (fn2-run-version sid n fn2-run-installed)) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
books/sealer.lisp:
; Layer C1c, the sealer's engine half (docs/c-ordered-runs.md §5): a
; published (frozen) overlay becomes a sealed run through the real build,
; with a Ribbon filter for the identity summary, is installed in the resident
; view of runs (fn2-run-installed), and the overlay is retired with its arena
; released, in one step. The engine half names runs and pages itself (a run
; counter and a physical-unit counter in the seal row) and keeps every sealed
; page resident in the verified-page cache; B's run-replacement member (GC2)
; makes the run durable (the device half). The sealer machine
; (machines-c-sealer.lisp) drives fn2-seal-step from its arms. One seal row;
; its continuation is the row (phase, the overlay, the next entry, the run).
;
; Order (C-SEAL-ORDER): an overlay is sealable when it is frozen and no
; overlay of its schema that is frozen, private or active has a smaller SEQ;
; of the sealable ones the least SEQ goes first. Run identifiers grow, so run
; order follows SEQ order, and every overlay a reader still meets is newer
; than every run, which is what the readers' newest-wins rules assume.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "machines-c-groups")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
(local (in-theory (disable fn2-run-layout-fields fn2-run-layout-keys fn2-run-layout-merge fn2-run-layout-size
                           fn2-fold-key-arg fn2-fold-arity fn2-fold-assigned-p fn2-run-layout-octets-max
                           fn2-run-layout-value-ok fn2-run-layout-fold-p fn2-run-version)))

; The seal row. WBASE: the build's six writer rows, then the filter's; FBASE:
; its field rows (the build's, then the decoded entry, then the filter
; writer's); CROW: its checker row (B's format-row map: 3 + the upload
; windows), whose digest stripe holds the six levels' parent-held hashes
; (regions 129-134) and the filter's (135); FILL: the page fill. RUN and UNIT
; count the identifiers handed out.
(defconst *fn2-seal-eb* *fn2-run-build-fields*)
(defconst *fn2-seal-fw* (+ *fn2-run-build-fields* *fn2-run-entry-rows*))
(defconst *fn2-seal-field-rows* (+ *fn2-seal-fw* *fn2-run-writer-fields*))
(defconst *fn2-seal-writer-rows* (+ 1 *fn2-run-max-levels*))
(defconst *fn2-seal-hash-region* 129)
(defconst *fn2-seal-filter-region* (+ *fn2-seal-hash-region* *fn2-run-max-levels*))
(assert-event (and (< *fn2-fc-previous-seal* *fn2-seal-hash-region*) (< *fn2-seal-filter-region* *fn2-digest-stride*)))
(defconst *fn2-seal-hash-bytes* (* 32 *fn2-run-max-levels*))
; The schema whose runs carry a Ribbon filter: the identity summary (§4a),
; keyed by the name N, which the identity decision reads first; the filter
; holds each entry's name.
(defconst *fn2-seal-identity* *fn2-id-summary-sid*)
(defconst *fn2-seal-filter-field* *fn2-identity-summary-entry-field-name*)
(defcolumns fn2-seals
 ((phase (:enum fn2-seal-phase (:idle :build :filter :install :failed :release)))
  (sub (:enum fn2-seal-sub (:open :clear :add :drive :finish :solve)))
  (history :u60) (history-incarnation :u60)
  (o :u32) (pos :u32) (sid :u60) (run :u60) (runs :u60) (units :u60)
  (top :u8) (rslot :u32) (rgen :u60) (runit :u60) (rcounter :u60) (entries :u60)
  (hslot :u32) (hgen :u60) (filter :bool) (funit :u60) (fcounter :u60)
  (wbase :u32) (fbase :u32) (crow :u32) (fill :u32) (okind :u8) (oslot :u32) (ogen :u60)
  (k :u8) (rlo :u60) (ufirst :u60) (held :bool) (rg :u32) (sbase :u32) (cbase :u32) (qbase :u32) (rbase :u32)))

; Shapes (type, wfp, rows of every stobj returned), with every table's rows
; accessor folded (the shape lemmas of the callees are stated over them).
(defconst *fn2-seal-rows-folded*
 '(fn2-seals-rows fn2-run-cache-rows fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-builds-rows fn2-run-writers-rows fn2-run-restarts-rows

; Set the seal row's resources: idle, no run or unit handed out yet.
(defun fn2-seal-init (wbase fbase crow pagefill okind oslot ogen history history-incarnation fn2-seals)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-seals :guard (fn2-seals-wfp fn2-seals)))
 (if (not (and (fn2-origin-physicalp history history-incarnation) (< 0 (fn2-seals-rows fn2-seals)) (unsigned-byte-p 32 wbase) (unsigned-byte-p 32 fbase)
               (unsigned-byte-p 32 crow) (unsigned-byte-p 32 pagefill) (unsigned-byte-p 8 okind)
               (unsigned-byte-p 32 oslot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 ogen)))
     (mv :bounds fn2-seals)
  (let ((fn2-seals (fn2-seals-put 0 (phase *fn2-seal-phase-idle*) (sub *fn2-seal-sub-open*) (o 0) (pos 0) (sid 0) (run 0)

                                  (runs 0) (units 0) (filter 0) (wbase wbase) (fbase fbase) (crow crow) (fill pagefill)
                                  (okind okind) (oslot oslot) (ogen ogen))))
   (mv :ok fn2-seals))))
(fn2-seal-shape fn2-seal-init (wbase fbase crow pagefill okind oslot ogen history history-incarnation fn2-seals) (fn2-seals) (fn2-seals))
; The merge's read resources (C5): range row RG, its eight sources from
; SBASE reading through run cursors from CBASE, the query key's field rows
; at QBASE and the sources' reader rows from RBASE.
(defun fn2-seal-merge-rows (rg sbase cbase qbase rbase fn2-seals)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-seals :guard (fn2-seals-wfp fn2-seals)))
 (if (not (and (< 0 (fn2-seals-rows fn2-seals)) (unsigned-byte-p 32 rg) (unsigned-byte-p 32 sbase) (unsigned-byte-p 32 cbase)
               (unsigned-byte-p 32 qbase) (unsigned-byte-p 32 rbase)))
     (mv :bounds fn2-seals)
  (let ((fn2-seals (fn2-seals-put 0 (k 0) (rlo 0) (held 0) (rg rg) (sbase sbase) (cbase cbase) (qbase qbase) (rbase rbase))))
   (mv :ok fn2-seals))))
(fn2-seal-shape fn2-seal-merge-rows (rg sbase cbase qbase rbase fn2-seals) (fn2-seals) (fn2-seals))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; The pick. Does an overlay of schema SID among rows O.. (K) in phase frozen,
; private or active have a SEQ below SEQ?
(defun fn2-seal-older-p (k o sid seq fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-overlays :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (natp o))))
 (and (posp k) (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays))
      (or (and (member (fn2-overlays-phase o fn2-overlays)
                       (list *fn2-overlay-phase-frozen* *fn2-overlay-phase-private* *fn2-overlay-phase-active*))
               (equal (fn2-overlays-schema o fn2-overlays) sid)
               (< (nfix (fn2-overlays-seq o fn2-overlays)) (nfix seq)))
          (fn2-seal-older-p (- k 1) (+ 1 o) sid seq fn2-overlays))))
(defun fn2-seal-sealable-p (o fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-overlays :guard (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays)))
 (and (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays))
      (equal (fn2-overlays-phase o fn2-overlays) *fn2-overlay-phase-frozen*)
      (not (fn2-seal-older-p (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays) 0 (fn2-overlays-schema o fn2-overlays)
                             (fn2-overlays-seq o fn2-overlays) fn2-overlays))))
; The sealable overlay with the least SEQ among rows O.. (K); BEST the row
; count when none.
(defun fn2-seal-pick (k o best fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-overlays :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (natp o))))
 (if (not (and (posp k) (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)))) best
  (fn2-seal-pick (- k 1) (+ 1 o)
                 (if (and (fn2-seal-sealable-p o fn2-overlays)
                          (or (not (and (natp best) (< best (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays))))
                              (< (nfix (fn2-overlays-seq o fn2-overlays)) (nfix (fn2-overlays-seq best fn2-overlays)))))
                     o best)
                 fn2-overlays)))
(defthm fn2-seal-pick-natp
 (implies (natp best) (natp (fn2-seal-pick k o best fn2-overlays))) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
; Work is pending in the seal row when it is in a non-idle active phase
; (:build, :filter, :install, :release), or when it is :idle and a published overlay is
; sealable.
(defun fn2-seal-pending-p (fn2-seals fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-seals fn2-overlays) :guard (and (fn2-seals-wfp fn2-seals) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays))))
 (and (< 0 (fn2-seals-rows fn2-seals))
      (let ((phase (fn2-seals-phase 0 fn2-seals)))
       (or (equal phase *fn2-seal-phase-build*)
           (equal phase *fn2-seal-phase-filter*)
           (equal phase *fn2-seal-phase-install*)
           (equal phase *fn2-seal-phase-release*)
           (and (equal phase *fn2-seal-phase-idle*)
                (< (fn2-seal-pick (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays) 0 (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays) fn2-overlays)
                   (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)))))))
(in-theory (disable fn2-seal-older-p fn2-seal-sealable-p fn2-seal-pick fn2-seal-pending-p))

; Retire overlay O (frozen -> free) and release its arena.
(defun fn2-seal-retire (o fn2-overlays fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-overlays fn2-pool) :guard (and (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-ov-retire fn2-ov-advance fn2-pool-release fn2-pool-release-countp)))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)))) (mv :bounds fn2-overlays fn2-pool))
      (slot (fn2-overlays-slot o fn2-overlays)) (gen (fn2-overlays-gen o fn2-overlays))
      (okind (fn2-overlays-okind o fn2-overlays)) (oslot (fn2-overlays-oslot o fn2-overlays)) (ogen (fn2-overlays-ogen o fn2-overlays))
      ((unless (fn2-pool-release-countp slot fn2-pool)) (mv :bounds fn2-overlays fn2-pool))
      ((mv code fn2-overlays) (fn2-ov-advance o *fn2-overlay-phase-frozen* *fn2-overlay-phase-free* fn2-overlays))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-overlays fn2-pool))
      ((mv code fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-release slot gen okind oslot ogen fn2-pool)))
  (mv code fn2-overlays fn2-pool)))
(fn2-seal-shape fn2-seal-retire (o fn2-overlays fn2-pool) (fn2-overlays fn2-pool) (fn2-overlays fn2-pool) t
 (fn2-ov-advance fn2-pool-release-countp fn2-overlays-slot fn2-overlays-gen fn2-overlays-okind fn2-overlays-oslot fn2-overlays-ogen))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; C5's merge, chosen when a seal starts (docs/c-ordered-runs.md §5). The
; frozen overlay O of schema SID is sealed together with SID's newest live
; runs (a suffix in run order, so the new run, whose identifier is greater
; than every run's, stands where they stood); its inputs retire when it
; installs and their pages are released unit by unit after it (:release).
; Size-tiered: a run joins while its entries are at most twice the entries
; gathered so far (O's, then each joined run's), so a schema holds about
; log2(entries) runs and an entry is rewritten about log2(n) times. Every
; run joins (FORCE) when the 64 KiB class or the installed view has at most
; one free row left (backpressure: the next seal needs a page and a row, and
; a merge frees its inputs'), or when the schema already holds
; *fn2-seal-run-budget* runs (a reader merges at most eight sources of a
; schema; stage keeps its overlays to the other four, machines-c.lisp). At
; most seven runs join, the overlay being the eighth source.
(defconst *fn2-seal-run-budget* *fn2-idc-run-budget*)
(defconst *fn2-seal-merge-runs* 7)
; Live runs of SID among rows R.. (K), and free rows.
(defun fn2-seal-live-runs (k r sid fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (natp r))))
 (if (not (and (posp k) (natp r) (< r (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed)))) 0
  (+ (if (and (equal (fn2-run-installed-state r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-installed-state-live*)
              (equal (fn2-run-installed-schema r fn2-run-installed) sid)) 1 0)
     (fn2-seal-live-runs (- k 1) (+ 1 r) sid fn2-run-installed))))
(defun fn2-seal-free-rows (k r fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (natp r))))
 (if (not (and (posp k) (natp r) (< r (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed)))) 0
  (+ (if (equal (fn2-run-installed-state r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-installed-state-free*) 1 0)
     (fn2-seal-free-rows (- k 1) (+ 1 r) fn2-run-installed))))
(defthm fn2-seal-live-runs-natp (natp (fn2-seal-live-runs k r sid fn2-run-installed)) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
(defthm fn2-seal-free-rows-natp (natp (fn2-seal-free-rows k r fn2-run-installed)) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
; The runs that join, newest first from below BOUND (I more at most), ACC
; the entries gathered: (mv count least-run).
(defun fn2-seal-select (i acc bound force sid fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :measure (nfix i) :guard (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed)))
 (b* (((unless (posp i)) (mv 0 0))
      (rows (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed))
      (r (fn2-succ-newest-run rows 0 sid bound rows fn2-run-installed))
      ((unless (and (natp r) (< r rows))) (mv 0 0))
      (e (nfix (fn2-run-installed-entries r fn2-run-installed)))
      (run (nfix (fn2-run-installed-run r fn2-run-installed)))
      ((unless (or force (<= e (* 2 (nfix acc))))) (mv 0 0))
      ((mv n least) (fn2-seal-select (- i 1) (+ (nfix acc) e) run force sid fn2-run-installed)))
  (mv (+ 1 (nfix n)) (if (equal (nfix n) 0) run (nfix least)))))
; Free rows of the page class (its free count; 0 when the pool has no such class).
(defun fn2-seal-free-pages (fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-pool :guard (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool)))
 (let ((class (fn2-pool-class-for *fn2-run-page-size* fn2-pool)))
  (if (and (natp class) (< class (fn2-pool-nclasses fn2-pool))) (nfix (fn2-pool-free-count class fn2-pool)) 0)))
; Among rows R.. (K), the live schema with the greatest live-run count
; above BEST-N (smaller SID breaking ties): (mv best best-n).
(defun fn2-seal-most-runs (k r best best-n fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :measure (nfix k)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (natp r) (natp best) (natp best-n))))
 (b* (((unless (and (posp k) (natp r) (< r (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed))))
       (mv (nfix best) (nfix best-n)))
      ((unless (equal (fn2-run-installed-state r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-installed-state-live*))
       (fn2-seal-most-runs (- k 1) (+ 1 r) best best-n fn2-run-installed))
      (sid (nfix (fn2-run-installed-schema r fn2-run-installed)))
      (n (fn2-seal-live-runs (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed) 0 sid fn2-run-installed))
      (better (or (< (nfix best-n) n) (and (equal n (nfix best-n)) (< sid (nfix best))))))
  (fn2-seal-most-runs (- k 1) (+ 1 r) (if better sid best) (if better n best-n) fn2-run-installed)))
(defthm fn2-seal-most-runs-types
 (and (natp (mv-nth 0 (fn2-seal-most-runs k r best best-n fn2-run-installed)))
      (natp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-seal-most-runs k r best best-n fn2-run-installed))))
 :rule-classes ((:type-prescription :corollary (natp (mv-nth 0 (fn2-seal-most-runs k r best best-n fn2-run-installed))))
                (:type-prescription :corollary (natp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-seal-most-runs k r best best-n fn2-run-installed))))))
; Pressure on the shared installed-run rows or 64 KiB page pool: proactive
; (merge the sealing schema's runs regardless of size ratio, and compact idle
; multi-run schemas once overlays drain) vs urgent (preemptively compact a
; multi-run schema before sealing a schema with <= 1 live run so the last free
; installed row or page is never consumed without freeing inputs).
(defun fn2-seal-pressured-p (fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))))
 (let ((rows (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed)))
  (or (<= (fn2-seal-free-rows rows 0 fn2-run-installed) (max 2 (floor rows 3)))
      (<= (fn2-seal-free-pages fn2-pool) 8))))
(defun fn2-seal-urgent-p (fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)
  :guard (and (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))))
 (let ((rows (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed)))
  (or (<= (fn2-seal-free-rows rows 0 fn2-run-installed) 2)
      (<= (fn2-seal-free-pages fn2-pool) 2))))
; Overlay O of SID with E entries: (mv count least-run) of the runs joining it.
(defun fn2-seal-plan (sid e fn2-run-installed fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-run-installed fn2-pool) :guard (and (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))))
 (let* ((rows (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed))

; Layer C1c: the sealer machine's core events (fn2-sealer-core-events,
; materialized in assembly-callbacks-c.lisp after the core instance): the
; core wrappers over the sealer's tables, C's attachment of the grant
; service's :sealable source, C's engine genesis, and the kind's
; continuations and run. Its own book, so a change here recertifies only the

;; The arms. :sealing: one seal step; more work keeps the row runnable;
;; nothing sealable (:idle) parks it on :sealable, which the grant service
;; wakes once an overlay is sealable. A seal that needs a page or a run row
;; merges first (C5, sealer.lisp: it joins the schema's runs whenever one
;; free page or row is left, and its install and release free theirs), so
;; :full is a pool that cannot hold one batch's runs and a merge; with no
;; wake for that, every other answer stops the core by name through fn2-sealer-refuse (:full is
;; :sealer-full, :cache :sealer-cache, any other :sealer) rather than park a
;; row nothing would wake, and moves the row to :stopped.
(defmachine-arms fn2-sealer :declare
 :arms
 ((:sealing
   (:do (code) (fn2-sealer-step 4096)
    :accept ()
    :case (((:more :retired :done) (:charge :bytes 4096 :steps *fn2-work-transition* :runnable t))
           ((:idle :busy) (:park :sealable :steps *fn2-work-transition*))
           (:otherwise
            (:do () (fn2-sealer-refuse code))
            (:set (stopped 1)) (:next :stopped)
            (:charge :bytes 4096 :steps *fn2-work-transition*)))))
  (:stopped (:idle))))

     (if (and (not (equal id *fn2-none*)) (fn2-machine-idp id fn2-core))

             (let ((fn2-core (fn2-sealer-put-core id (wait-reason *fn2-wait-sealable*)))) (mv :ok fn2-core))
           (let ((fn2-core (fn2-sealer-put-core id (phase *fn2-sealer-state-stopped*) (stopped 1) (wait-reason *fn2-wait-none*))))
